CustomField.formula: IF( AND(RPM_Assessment_Score__c >= 0 , RPM_Assessment_Score__c <= 40), 'D', IF( AND(RPM_Assessment_Score__c > 40 ,RPM_Assessment_Score__c <= 60), 'C', IF( AND(RPM_Assessment_Score__c > 60 ,RPM_Assessment_Score__c <= 80), 'B', IF( AND(RPM_Assessment_Score__c > 80 , RPM_Assessment_Score__c <= 100), 'A', '' ))))
CustomField.label: RPM Assessment Score Grade
